project_metadata.job_description:
Job Description:

We have a sales page that is about 95% complete I would say:
https://jim-liao-ddb0.mykajabi.com/encore-page-1780470506-1-0ac36545-1d1d-424d-81b5-3bd227cf63ad?preview_theme_id=2166866502

We just need the following revisions:

1. Format top block. It should clearly look off right now.

2. For the middle section (the section with the 第 1-7 天, 第 8-14 天, 第 15-21 天 headers), we plan to change the background color to black. We therefore need to add some kind of dividing line in-between each block to help make the separation between each block clearer. 

3. Adjust the picture in the 第 1-7 天 block. It is not aligned with the header.

4. Help delete a bunch of extraneous blocks across the document.

About the candidate: Doesn't have to be highly experienced, just needs to be familiar with and efficient in creating sales pages on Kajabi. . Due to use of Chinese language, designers fluent in Chinese will be preferred, although it is not required. In the case that the designer is not fluent in Chinese, it's best they have translation tools at hand to at least grasp the context of the contents  being worked with. The workflow will be such that there will be quite a bit of back-and-forth between us, such as where I say what to do, you do it, i check, and then give next instructions etc. Therefore, the candidate has to have a strong sense of communication and following instructions and has to have availability that is geared towards being available around the clock rather than at set periods.
